title: Turn on Claude Code's built-in stale tool-result clearing for lead sessions
body:
Outcome: the lead's long sessions get stale tool results cleared through a lever that runs inside Claude Code, proven by `context_management.applied_edits` entries of type `clear_tool_uses_20250919` in a real transcript and a lower median per-turn context (scripts/claude/context-report.ts), or a recorded proof that each lever below is unavailable.
Why: operator 2026-11-09: "jak znajdziesz na to realnie dojebany sposób to nie opuszczaj tej idei". t-c8nb5xr (#515) closed as no lever, but the Claude Code 2.1.319 binary contains a built-in client: `tengu_tool_result_clearing_after_idle_*`, a planner that sends `{type:"clear_tool_uses_20250919", trigger, keep, clear_at_least}` with beta `context-management-2025-06-27` after an idle return, gated by remote flag `tengu_jiggly_blossom` (values off|shadow|on, default off). Flags read local overrides from env `CLAUDE_INTERNAL_FC_OVERRIDES` (GrowthBook `readEnvironmentOverrides`); `CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_ALLOW_FLAG_OVERRIDES` may gate it.
Levers to probe, in order: (1) `CLAUDE_INTERNAL_FC_OVERRIDES='{"tengu_jiggly_blossom":"on"}'` (with and without CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_ALLOW_FLAG_OVERRIDES=1) in a headless probe session that makes tool calls, idles past the trigger, and resumes; read applied_edits from its transcript; (2) other env knobs found in the binary: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, CLAUDE_CODE_COLD_COMPACT, CLAUDE_CODE_SLEEP_COMPACT(_AFTER_MS), CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS, CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_SLIM_TOOL_RESULTS; (3) a localhost proxy via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL that injects context_management is out of bounds without an operator decision (global rule: never route Anthropic credentials elsewhere).
Proof: a committed probe script and its verbatim captured transcript lines; if a lever works, enable it in project settings env with a test pinning it.
Scope: scripts/claude, .claude/settings.json, test/claude.
